name: Ren-ai Holic
source:
The software you had ordered, "Kagami● Len" arrived. You started the installation immediately and happily. Suddenly a bright light filled the room and a real Len appeared in front of you!

"Nice to meet you, Master." Len said cheerfully. You were so surprised you couldn't say anything.

You had been in a slump, but now feel strangely healed.

Your life with Len now begins.

[translated and edited from [url=http://maniax.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RJ069282.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
你订购的软件“镜音●连”送到了。你兴高采烈地立刻开始安装。突然，耀眼的光芒充满房间，真正的连出现在你面前！

“初次见面，主人。”连开朗地说道。你震惊得一句话也说不出来。

你原本正处于低潮，如今却莫名得到治愈。

与连共同生活的日子就此开始。

[根据[url=http://maniax.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RJ069282.html]DLsite[/url]翻译并编辑]
